proceedings.title: Section 34 challenge
provisions: Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996

limitation.title: Application to set aside an award
limitation.from: the date on which the party making the application received the award

workflow.text: Analyse the award and the record it rests on.
Report on the arbitration agreement, the seat, the venue and the law.
Chart the claims, the defence and the counterclaim.
Draft the Section 34 challenge with the grounds tied to the record.
Review the draft against the award and the record.

intakeQuestions: When was the award received, and is the 90-day period running?
What is the seat and the venue named in the agreement?
Which grounds under Section 34 does the record support?
Was there a Section 16 objection or an application under Section 9?
